abstract: Connect SillyTavern, the local character-chat and roleplay front end, to self-hosted LLM servers. Covers the git and Docker install, Chat Completion with the Custom OpenAI-compatible source and the Claude reverse proxy, Text Completion types for vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama and Generic, key handling in secrets.json, additional body parameters and headers, prompt post-processing, tool calling, streaming, Connection Profiles, listen, whitelist and SSRF settings, and troubleshooting, with a config.yaml snippet and a read-only endpoint probe script.
